label: The Traveler
tagline: Universal in, universal out — no country in the chrome.
cluster_explainer: The Traveler treats the engine as a portable, borderless artifact — universal audio in, universal image out, and nothing in the UI that would translate the user into a customer.
demo_highlights: Sphere is the geometry of no nation — same curve in every language, no local accent for the eye to read.
Cassette preset evokes lo-fi portability: the artifact you can carry across a border without it changing flavor.
Mid-band dominance matches the band where speech and street audio live — the universal layer of human sound.
Smooth envelope (0.7) lets a fragment from one city and a fragment from another compose without seams between them.
No chrome, no flag, no language picker in the demo itself: the artifact travels without translation or caption.
